definitions.puboperineales muscle: A muscle of the pelvis that arises from the inner surface of the pubic bone and inserts into the perineal body, forming part of the pubovisceral component of the levator ani muscle and contributing to support of the pelvic floor and elevation of the perineal body.

name_corrections.label: puboperineales muscle
name_corrections.reason: TA2 Latin form is 'musculus puboperinealis' (singular); 'puboperineales' is the plural Latin adjective form used inconsistently. The standard English label is 'puboperinealis muscle' or 'puboperineal muscle'. Keep source name as a synonym.
